title: How AI chatbots and fake photos are playing with your mind to create false memories
script:
MIT researchers proved AI can rewrite your memories.
A new study shows chatbots can plant fake facts in your mind.
Researchers at MIT Media Lab tested conversational AI on human subjects.
Participants watched a crime scene video before chatting with a generative AI.
The chatbot asked leading questions that subtly introduced false details.
Separately, fake photos were used to test visual memory distortion.
Thirty-six point four percent of user responses adopted the chatbot's fabrications.
After a brief conversation, participants remembered details that never happened.
Would you trust a memory an AI suggested?
